title: chore: remove dashboard status notice
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the dashboard-wide status notice banner.
- Stops fetching `/api/status-notice` from the dashboard.
- Leaves the admin/status API unchanged.

Checks:
- `npx biome check frontend/src/components/layout/dashboard-shell.tsx`
- `git diff --check`
- Enter typecheck could not start because `tsup` is not installed in this checkout.

gist.headline: The banner flew south
gist.blurb: The dashboard status banner has been gently packed away. One less thing hovering over the workspace.
gist.summary: Removed the dashboard-wide status notice banner and its `/api/status-notice` fetch while leaving the admin status API available.
gist.impact: Dashboard users get a cleaner workspace without the persistent status notice, while administrators retain status API access.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy dashboard garden after a large notice banner has been removed: Polli tidies the newly open space on a retro terminal desk while small code-plants and flowers grow around it. A tiny folded banner rests in a basket, signaling UI cleanup without implying the status system itself disappeared.
